messages:
Maya: Need a tight SEO handoff for tomorrow's webinar page. Focus: keywords for hero + FAQ, redirect plan for legacy promos, recommended JSON-LD, and link anchors. Who can own which part?
Ben: Ill own keyword targets + hero copy. Proposals: primary - 'production LLM serving', 'LLM inference optimization'; support - 'inference batching', 'KV cache for LLMs', 'reducing LLM latency'
Rosa: Ill handle redirects + canonical. Two legacy routes to retire: /promo/edge-ai-2025 and /events/edge-launch. We'll 301 both -> /webinars/serving-llms. No meta-refresh.
Ben: Hero H1 suggestion: "Production LLM Serving: Fast, Cost-Effective Inference"
Rosa: Nginx snippet for infra:
```
location = /promo/edge-ai-2025 {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-llms;
}
location = /events/edge-launch {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-llms;
}
```
Maya: Schema: Event + FAQ. Ben can drop a JSON-LD example?
Ben: JSON-LD (paste to CMS head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar - Serving LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-06-26T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/serving-llms"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Rosa: Internal linking plan: from Blog "Use cases" -> Benchmarks -> Webinar -> Docs. Suggested anchor texts: 'real-world latency', 'throughput benchmarks', 'register for webinar', 'integration guide'.
ops-bot: scan: found 4 pages missing Event schema; recommend adding Event JSON-LD on landing and FAQ markup on pages with Qs.
Maya: Action owners: Ben - final KW + JSON-LD; Rosa - infra PR for redirects + canonical headers; Ops - quick crawl after deploy. Need PRs by EOD.
Rosa: Will open PR now and tag infra.
Ben: I'll upload hero copy and KW to CMS before lunch.
Maya: Thanks team. Ping here when done :thumbsup:
